What if the people who win don't feel like they're working at all?

Kevin Trudeau says successful people are obsessed with their mission, their idea, their project. They eat, drink and sleep it.

To them it doesn't feel like work. It gives them joy, and they love the act of creating.

When did you last lose track of time doing something you love?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

Think a thought, and nothing vibrates. Say it out loud, and your whole brain does.

Kevin Trudeau explains that when you only listen, just your eardrum vibrates. When you speak, your whole head and brain vibrate.

He says this is why professional athletes give themselves pep talks out loud, and why spoken words build different neural pathways than silent thoughts.

What would you say out loud to yourself right now?
